• Connects to Cassandra
• Reads tenanta_analytics.window_results
for last 24h filtered by country
• Computes hourly avg PM2.5, peak window,
alert breach count
• Saves result to /tmp/batch_result_{country}.parquet
• Retries 3x on failure
